ruleset.name: petstore
ruleset.description:
petstore — SEMANTICS ONLY. Formatting belongs to php-cs-fixer via conduction/coding-standard; see .php-cs-fixer.dist.php.
This file used to carry the whole ~200-line PEAR-derived ruleset plus a local copy of three custom sniffs. Both are gone: the ruleset now comes from conduction/hydra-gates (one copy, fleet-wide) and the sniffs come with it. A local copy of a shared rule is not a shared rule — the fleet reached six versions of NamedParametersSniff.php that way, one of them calling addWarning() where the rest called addError().
